_comment: Curated ACCEPTED divergences (not bugs). Highest-precedence classification in gen-ledger: overrides the auto 'flagged: verify' from the Layer-2 read diff. deep_verified stays as the live layers report it (these do not diff clean vs Jellyfin by design). Sourced from the parity-triage workflow verdicts (parity/triage-findings.json) + the roadmap synthesis, minus the ops since fixed (Filters2 WI-2, Collections add/remove WI-6, Images Size WI-1).

GET /IntroSkipper/SupportBundle.classification: expected-extension: IntroSkipper is a compiled-in Hermit plugin; stock Jellyfin 10.11.8 lacks it (H=200 vs J=404). By design.

GET /Items/Suggestions.classification: instance/methodology: Jellyfin orders suggestions by Random, so the set is non-deterministic across independent scans (matches Jellyfin's behavior).

GET /Items/{itemId}/Ancestors.classification: instance: ancestor set differs only by /config-vs-/data path-derived ids + the deliberately-omitted synthetic root/aggregate folder tree (documented out-of-scope).

GET /Items/{itemId}/Similar.classification: deferred: weighted GetSimilarityScore scorer not ported; the single-year metadata-poor fixture also has no stable target (every candidate ties under Jellyfin's Random tiebreak).

GET /Movies/{itemId}/Similar.classification: deferred: same weighted similarity scorer as Items/{id}/Similar.

GET /Movies/Recommendations.classification: deferred: Hermit seeds recommendations off DateCreated recency, not user behavior (played/favorites/people). Real gap but L-effort and only observable on a fixture with user data.

GET /Search/Hints.classification: deferred: search path is correct; the missing Genre hint is because remote metadata (TMDB) is feature-gated off and the synthetic fixture carries no NFO <genre>.

GET /LiveTv/ListingProviders/SchedulesDi.classification: deferred: Jellyfin proxies json.schedulesdirect.org; Hermit has no Schedules Direct DVR provider (returns empty). Subsystem decision.

GET /UserViews.classification: instance: view Path (and path-derived id) differ only by /config vs /data data-dir; identical under a shared data-dir.

GET /Library/MediaFolders.classification: instance: after WI-7 the folder COUNT matches; residual is /config-vs-/data path-alignment noise on the folder rows.

GET /Albums/{itemId}/Similar.classification: deferred: weighted similarity scorer not ported (same as Items/{id}/Similar).

GET /Artists/{itemId}/Similar.classification: deferred: weighted similarity scorer not ported.

GET /Shows/{itemId}/Similar.classification: deferred: weighted similarity scorer not ported.

GET /Trailers/{itemId}/Similar.classification: deferred: weighted similarity scorer not ported.

GET /Plugins.classification: expected-extension: Hermit uses compiled-in extensions, not external-repo plugins.

GET /Packages.classification: expected-extension: no external plugin package repository (compiled-in extensions).

GET /Repositories.classification: expected-extension: no external plugin repositories configured (compiled-in extensions).

GET /web/ConfigurationPages.classification: expected-extension: plugin configuration pages come from external plugins Hermit doesn't host.

GET /Items/{itemId}/ExternalIdInfos.classification: deferred: external-id provider metadata (TMDB/etc.) is feature-gated off.

GET /Items/{itemId}/RemoteImages.classification: deferred: remote image providers feature-gated off.

GET /Items/{itemId}/RemoteImages/Provide.classification: deferred: remote image providers feature-gated off.

GET /Items/{itemId}.classification: instance/probe-noise: residual diffs are MediaStream probe values (BitRate/IsAVC/Level/RealFrameRate) that vary per independent probe, plus Localized* (needs localization on read-back, deferred).

GET /Items/{itemId}/PlaybackInfo.classification: instance/probe-noise: same MediaStream probe-value residual as Items/{itemId}.

GET /Years.classification: expected-extension: Hermit does not materialize Year items (documented out-of-scope).

GET /ScheduledTasks.classification: instance: LastExecutionResult depends on whether/when a task last ran.

GET /System/Info/Storage.classification: instance: per-host disk paths and free/used space.

GET /System/Ping.classification: instance: returns the server name string (hermit vs the Jellyfin instance name).

GET /Library/PhysicalPaths.classification: instance: data-dir-relative physical paths differ by container (/config vs /data).

GET /System/Logs.classification: instance: log-file set differs per instance/run.

GET /System/ActivityLog/Entries.classification: instance: activity-log entries differ per instance/run.

GET /LiveTv/GuideInfo.classification: instance: now-relative guide window (now .. now+7d) matches Jellyfin's behavior, but the exact StartDate/EndDate timestamps can't match across two independently-clocked servers.

GET /System/Configuration.classification: instance/methodology: real default fields (PluginRepositories/EnableLegacyAuthorization/CacheSize) now match; residual IsStartupWizardCompleted/IsPortAuthorized reflect the harness completing Jellyfin's wizard during setup while Hermit auto-seeds — setup state, not a bug.

GET /LiveTv/TunerHosts/Types.classification: deferred: Hermit implements only the M3U tuner-host type and correctly advertises only that; HDHomeRun/etc. tuner hosts are unported.

POST /Items/{itemId}.classification: instance/methodology: the metadata edit persists correctly on Hermit (read-back reflects it); Jellyfin's read-back didn't reflect the synthetic tag-edit body (oracle/body difference), so this is not a Hermit defect.

GET /Items/{itemId}/MetadataEditor.classification: deferred: Countries/ParentalRatings/ContentTypeOptions now match; the only residual is ExternalIdInfos, which is empty because remote-id providers (TMDB/etc.) are feature-gated off.

POST /Sessions/Playing/Progress.classification: instance/methodology: the harness read-back check (item UserData.PlaybackPositionTicks) doesn't reflect a bare progress ping on EITHER server (needs a real PlaySessionId to correlate); the endpoint itself accepts the report — not a Hermit defect.

DELETE /Playlists/{playlistId}/Users/{us.classification: instance/methodology: Hermit correctly removes the playlist share (H read-back shows it gone); Jellyfin's read-back still lists it (oracle behavior), so this is not a Hermit defect.
